finding.verified: The KSU Tabari note cites al-Farra, Ma'ani al-Qur'an, p. 377 without a volume or edition. In the same IslamWeb digital work, part 2 page 377 is under Ya-Sin 36:32, whereas the al-Kawthar poem is shown in part 3 page 296. Earlier recorded page-377 references also include part 1. Therefore the bare locator is not unique across volumes.
finding.implication: A page number alone cannot identify KSU's witness; volume and edition are needed. This strengthens the locator hold but does not identify the source KSU used.
finding.non_finding: No volume-3 p.377 image, title page, or colophon was retrieved. No variant or authorial-reading decision follows.
